text:
tablet_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active electronics during the day.
glass_felix: Assumed kitchen_table_k1 or nightstand_b1; actually cupboard_k1. Check cupboard_k1 for stored drinkware, especially in the evening.
charger_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually entry_hook_e1. Check entry_hook_e1 for charging accessories when leaving/arriving.
mug_felix: Assumed cupboard_k1; actually kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware.
razor_felix: Assumed medicine_cabinet_ba1 or bathroom_shelf_ba1; actually sink_ba_ba1. Check sink_ba_ba1 first for grooming items.
water_bottle_felix: Assumed kitchen_table_k1; actually cupboard_k1. Check cupboard_k1 for stored drinkware, especially in the evening.
book_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually bed_b1. Check bed_b1 for reading materials.
